fixes.explanation: An altar sounds serious, and I see the pull. But look at what Jesus says: “…so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom…” The disciples are getting a meal, not a ceremony. I think that's a pretty big honor for men who had just been arguing about who was the greatest.

A gate is a way in, and I see the pull. But Jesus is talking about eating and drinking: “…so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom…” Nobody ever walked up to a gate and got handed a cookie. I bet these disciples were glad their invitation led somewhere with food.
